findings.desc: CHK-001:happy:0 evidence command does not bind the intent literal: intent requires node -e filter matching /^test:.*-smoke$/ printing count=1 (only test:run-all-smokes-smoke); evidence runs python3 counting all test:* entries (returns 12). The evidence covers happy:1 (total test:* count), not happy:0 (smoke-specific count=1). The CHK-001:happy:0 intent — confirming exactly 1 test:*-smoke remains — has no valid evidence.
